main.description: AppView-curated list of featured emoji, stickers and packs, chosen by this AppView's administrators. Public. Subjects are re-derived from indexed records, so deleted or taken-down subjects are omitted. An item with stickerFormats is returned under 'stickers' (it may also be used inline); items with only 'formats' are returned under 'emoji'.

featuredUris.description: Only populated for administrators: every featured subject URI, including ones that currently fail to resolve, so they can be un-featured.

viewerIsAdmin.description: Whether the authenticated viewer may call setFeatured.
